mapper.select: select ktp.id, ktp.plan_url 'planUrl', ktp.begin_date 'beginDate', su.nick_name 'createBy', su.avatar 'avatar', ktp.create_time 'createTime', ktp.update_time 'updateTime' from kg_teaching_program ktp join sys_user su on ktp.create_by = su.user_id where ktp.class_id = (select class_id from kg_student where id = #{studentId} and del_flag = 0 and is_leave_school = 0) and ktp.del_flag = 0 order by ktp.create_time desc

select kc.class_name 'className', ktp.plan_url 'planUrl', ktp.begin_date 'beginDate', su.nick_name 'createBy', su.avatar 'avatar', ktp.create_time 'createTime' from kg_teaching_program ktp join sys_user su on ktp.create_by = su.user_id and su.del_flag = 0 and su.status = 0 join kg_classroom kc on ktp.class_id = kc.id and kc.del_flag = 0 where ktp.kg_id = #{student.kgId} and ktp.class_id = #{student.classId} and ktp.id = #{id} and ktp.del_flag = 0
